content:
Apple One will get even better in iOS 27, with subscribers benefiting from new features across bundled Apple services like iCloud+ and Apple Music. Here's the latest.

#1: Enhanced access to new Apple Intelligence features

iOS 27 includes major Apple Intelligence upgrades, including a new Siri AI, powerful editing tools for Apple Photos, improved image generation, and more.

While these features will be available for free to all users, some have daily usage caps that vary based on your Apple One tier.

We don't yet know the exact increases to AI usage limits, but every Apple One plan includes iCloud+, and recent evidence suggests higher tiers get progressively higher limits.

#2: Four new HomeKit Secure Video upgrades

HomeKit Secure Video, another iCloud+ perk, is getting four new features in iOS 27. Apple says:

  • 4K video: "Supported HomeKit Secure Video cameras can now stream and record in 4K"
  • Automatically generated video descriptions: "Users can quickly understand what's happening across a series of video clips, even without watching them"
  • Search within video clips: "(Users) can easily find what they want to see, such as a package delivery"
  • Highlights: "At the top of the search page, the Home app will surface highlights users likely want to view, making it easy to quickly browse important moments"

All of these improvements will be available to all Apple One subscribers when iOS 27 launches. You just need a compatible smart camera and home hub. Here are my top picks:

  • Aqara G100 2K security camera: a great budget pick for just $39
  • eufy 4K security camera: supports 4K and is still affordable at just $54

#3: Apple Music improvements

Finally, Apple Music is getting a slate of new features and improvements in iOS 27.

  • Redesigned artist and album pages
  • Now Playing interface while iPhone is in landscape orientation
  • AutoMix with "smoother transitions for a more immersive experience"
  • AutoMix comes to Apple TV and HomePod
  • Hi-Res Lossless audio streaming in tvOS 27

Plus, Lyrics Translation and Lyrics Pronunciation are expanding to more languages. Apple says:

Lyrics Translation adds seven new language pairs, seamlessly translating the lyrics of users' favorite songs, including English to French, English to German, English to Italian, English to Korean, English to Spanish, French to English, and Japanese to English. […] Lyrics Pronunciation helps users sing along in a different language with proper pronunciation, also adding five new language pairs: Arabic to Romanized Arabic, English to Korean characters, English to Katakana, Japanese to Korean characters, and Mandarin Chinese (Simplified) to Katakana.

Apple also highlighted several important bug fixes, including improved streaming stability, faster Now Playing loading, and quicker playback launch.

Which new Apple One feature in iOS 27 are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments.

Apple One starts at $19.95/month and includes Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+, and more.
